answers.core: The text_file.cpp already exists as a Resource within Godot, albeit not yet exposed in the engine. Hence, the integration of this enhancement merely involves exposing it and implementing the ResourceFormatLoader abstract class.
answers.workaround: As previously mentioned, one could bypass the need for this enhancement by converting the text file to an already implemented resource format like JSON. However, this approach is a very slow workflow and necessitates the creation of a custom function to extract the text from the JSON file.

title: Exposing text_file.cpp as a Resource with ResourceFormatLoaderText
